CREATE TABLE "public"."anuncio_favoritos" (
  "anuncio_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "anuncio_favoritos_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."anuncio_midias" (
  "anuncio_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ordem" int2 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "url" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "anuncio_midias_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncio_midias_ordem" CHECK ((ordem >= 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."anuncios" (
  "cidade" character varying(100),
  "condicao" character varying(15) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descricao" text,
  "esporte_id" int4,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6),
  "longitude" numeric(9,6),
  "preco" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "status" character varying(15) DEFAULT 'ativo' NOT NULL,
  "titulo" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "anuncios_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_condicao" CHECK (((condicao)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['novo'::character varying, 'seminovo'::character varying, 'usado'::character varying])::text[]))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_coord" CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_lat" CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_lng" CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_preco" CHECK ((preco >= (0)::numeric)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_anuncios_status" CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ativo'::character varying, 'pausado'::character varying, 'vendido'::character varying, 'removido'::character varying])::text[])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."atividades" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descricao" character varying(500),
  "esporte_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "expira_em" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "status" character varying(20) DEFAULT 'aberta' NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "atividades_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_atividades_expira" CHECK ((expira_em > created_at)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_atividades_lat" CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_atividades_lng" CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_atividades_status" CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['aberta'::character varying, 'em_andamento'::character varying, 'concluida'::character varying, 'cancelada'::character varying, 'expirada'::character varying])::text[])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."avaliacoes" (
  "anuncio_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "avaliado_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "avaliador_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "comentario" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nota" int2 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "avaliacoes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_avaliacoes_diferentes" CHECK ((avaliado_id <> avaliador_id)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_avaliacoes_nota" CHECK (((nota >= 1) AND (nota <= 5)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comentarios" (
  "conteudo" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "publicacao_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "comentarios_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_comentarios_conteudo" CHECK ((length(btrim(conteudo)) > 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."compartilhamentos" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "publicacao_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "compartilhamentos_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversa_participantes" (
  "conversa_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "conversa_participantes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversas" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "tipo" character varying(10) DEFAULT 'direta' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "conversas_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_conversas_tipo" CHECK (((tipo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['direta'::character varying, 'grupo'::character varying])::text[])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."curtidas" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "publicacao_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "curtidas_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."esportes" (
  "cor" character varying(7) DEFAULT '#000000' NOT NULL,
  "icone" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "esportes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_esportes_cor" CHECK (((cor)::text ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'::text))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mensagens" (
  "conteudo" text NOT NULL,
  "conversa_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lida" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "remetente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "mensagens_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_mensagens_conteudo" CHECK ((length(btrim(conteudo)) > 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publicacao_midias" (
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ordem" int2 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "publicacao_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tipo" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "url" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "publicacao_midias_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_publicacao_midias_ordem" CHECK ((ordem >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_publicacao_midias_tipo" CHECK (((tipo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['imagem'::character varying, 'video'::character varying])::text[])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publicacoes" (
  "conteudo" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "esporte_id" int4,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6),
  "longitude" numeric(9,6),
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "publicacoes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_publicacoes_coord" CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_publicacoes_lat" CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_publicacoes_lng" CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."seguidores" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "seguido_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "seguidor_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "seguidores_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_seguidores_diferentes" CHECK ((seguidor_id <> seguido_id))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuario_esportes" (
  "esporte_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nivel" character varying(20) DEFAULT 'iniciante' NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "usuario_esportes_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_usuario_esportes_nivel" CHECK (((nivel)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['iniciante'::character varying, 'intermediario'::character varying, 'avancado'::character varying, 'profissional'::character varying])::text[])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuarios" (
  "bio" text,
  "cidade" character varying(100),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "foto_perfil_url" character varying(500),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6),
  "longitude" numeric(9,6),
  "nome" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "senha_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "sobrenome" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "usuarios_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_usuarios_coord" CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_usuarios_lat" CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_usuarios_lng" CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric)))
)
